artifacts.description: fix(io): name the file, not a folder, in .sltwx extension errors

acceptance_criteria: The extension-mismatch message names the right subject: "folder" from `read_unpacked`/`write_unpacked`, "file" from `read_sltwx`/`write_sltwx`, for both the wrong-extension and the no-extension forms. Either a field on `ExtensionMismatch` or a separate documented variant is fine; never a panic.
Unit tests in `swx-io` check both messages from both forms.
Existing tests and the `unpacked_document` and `packed_document` examples still build and run.
`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` pass.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR.
objective.description: M4-01e: swx-io: extension-mismatch message says "folder" for a single .sltwx file
